endpoint: repeatable processed-data calibration with retained failure and rejection evidence
success_rule: 3/3 controls reproduce, 0 failed/rejected attempts enter selection, receipts replay and fresh computations agree
evaluation: same exposed calibration fixture, repeated after freeze; not a biological holdout

requires: current prices and explicit funded envelope
frozen identical access/memory/model/tool configuration across agent arms

limits: Software repetitions are not biological replicates.
No agent organization or intelligence effect is estimated.
Reference results are supplied to the scripted control, so recovery does not measure discovery ability.
